name: Andaman & Nicobar
tagline: Emerald Isles — Coral Reefs, Turquoise Lagoons & White Sands
shortDescription: Planning an island holiday is easy with an Andaman tour package that combines hotels, sightseeing, transfers, and activities in one plan. Enjoy beautiful beaches, clear waters, peaceful islands and exciting activities.
fullOverview: An Andaman tour package is designed to make your island vacation comfortable and well-organized. Depending on the package you select, it may include hotel accommodation, airport transfers, sightseeing, ferry tickets, meals, and selected activities. You can choose a short trip for a quick escape or a longer holiday to explore more islands. Couples may prefer romantic stays and beach experiences, while families often look for comfortable hotels, easy transfers, and child-friendly activities. The biggest advantage is convenience — instead of arranging every part of your holiday separately, you can have most travel arrangements planned in advance.
bestTime: October to May (Calm turquoise waters, ideal for diving & sea transfers)
highlights: Port Blair — historical sites, local markets and the waterfront
Havelock Island — beautiful beaches, clear water and water activities
Radhanagar Beach, a major attraction on Havelock
Neil Island — a quieter island experience away from busy tourist areas
Scuba diving in clear waters with marine life
Snorkeling for colourful fish without advanced diving skills

howToReach.air: Veer Savarkar International Airport, Port Blair (IXZ) with direct flights from Chennai, Kolkata, Delhi, and Bengaluru.
howToReach.road: Island hopping is conducted via modern luxury catamarans and private tourist cabs.

topAttractions.name: Port Blair
topAttractions.description: Often the starting point for an Andaman tour package. Home to several important attractions and a convenient base for exploring nearby destinations — historical sites, local markets and the waterfront.

topAttractions.name: Havelock Island
topAttractions.description: One of the most popular stops, known for its beautiful beaches, clear water and exciting water activities. Radhanagar Beach is a major attraction, and visitors can also enjoy snorkeling, scuba diving and peaceful beach walks.

topAttractions.name: Neil Island
topAttractions.description: A wonderful choice for travellers looking for a quieter island experience. Beautiful beaches, natural surroundings and a relaxed atmosphere — ideal for spending time away from busy tourist areas.

stayCategories.recommendation: Focus on essential travel services without adding unnecessary luxury — simple and comfortable hotels, shared transfers and selected sightseeing to keep costs under control.
Families can choose comfortable hotels, convenient transfers and activities suitable for different age groups.
Couples may prefer romantic stays and beach experiences as part of the package.

travelTips: Compare different packages instead of selecting the first option you find. Check the hotel category, inclusions, transportation and sightseeing details.
Book your trip in advance whenever possible. Early planning can give you more choices of hotels and travel dates.
Select a package that focuses on the places and activities you genuinely want to experience, and avoid paying extra for services you do not need.
Travelling during the less busy season can help you get better value.
Travelling with family or friends can make certain travel costs easier to manage.
Before booking, carefully check what is included and what may require an additional payment.
Weather conditions can change, so it is always useful to check the latest travel information before your journey.

faqs.question: Why choose an Andaman tour package?
faqs.answer: An Andaman tour package can save both time and effort. Planning hotels, transportation, sightseeing and island transfers independently can be confusing, especially if you are visiting Andaman for the first time. A package allows you to have a planned itinerary while still leaving enough free time to relax and enjoy the destination. Many packages can also be customized according to the number of travellers, hotel category, activities and places you want to visit.

faqs.question: What is included in an Andaman tour package?
faqs.answer: The inclusions depend on the travel provider and package category. Common inclusions may include hotel accommodation, airport or hotel transfers, island transfers, sightseeing, ferry tickets, selected meals, local transportation, activity arrangements and tour assistance. Before booking, carefully check what is included and what may require an additional payment.

faqs.question: What are the top activities to enjoy in Andaman?
faqs.answer: Scuba diving is one of the most popular experiences — the clear waters and marine life provide an opportunity to explore the underwater world. If you prefer a simpler water activity, snorkeling lets you see colourful fish and underwater surroundings without needing advanced diving skills. Beaches are an important part of any Andaman trip, whether that is relaxing on the sand, enjoying the sunsets or simply taking in the island atmosphere.

faqs.question: Is Andaman suitable for a family trip?
faqs.answer: Yes. An Andaman tour package is a great option for families because it can reduce the stress of planning transportation and sightseeing. Families can choose comfortable hotels, convenient transfers and activities suitable for different age groups, and a well-planned itinerary should include enough time for both sightseeing and relaxation.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Andaman?
faqs.answer: Choosing the right travel season can make your trip more enjoyable. October to May brings calm turquoise waters that suit diving and sea transfers. Weather conditions can change, so it is always useful to check the latest travel information before your journey — particularly if you are planning snorkeling, scuba diving or island hopping, where sea conditions matter.

faqs.question: How do you book the best Andaman tour deal?
faqs.answer: Start by understanding your travel requirements: how many days you want to stay, how many people are travelling, your preferred hotel category and your approximate budget. Then compare package itineraries carefully — destinations covered, accommodation, transfers, meals, activities and other inclusions. Do not choose a package based only on its price; a slightly different package may offer better convenience or more useful inclusions.
